summary: NextNRG, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a material definitive agreement: a securities purchase agreement for a private placement of 10,000,000 common shares at $0.64/share for $6.4M gross proceeds, closed May 27, 2026. Proceeds will fund growth, working capital, and repay $2.415M of convertible debt. The company must file a resale registration statement within 10 days and use best efforts for effectiveness within 30-60 days. A 30-day issuance blackout and 60-day ATM/variable-rate transaction ban apply, along with 60-day lock-ups for directors and officers. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event.
